text:
Jordan (Acme Integrations): hey team — after we moved our API into Dedicated VPC we're seeing intermittent 403s. end-user says token is present. works if they hit the pod directly, fails when going through our L7 proxy/ALB.
Maya: thx — can you paste a curl example that reproduces? and which proxy (ALB/NLB/istio) sits in front?
Jordan (Acme Integrations): using our internal ALB -> istio ingressgateway -> service. curl that fails: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ey..." https://api.internal.acme.example.com/v1/complete
```
response: 403 unauthorized. when we curl the pod ip (bypassing istio) same token returns 200.
Ashok: that strongly suggests an auth header is being stripped or rewritten in the ingress chain. does the ALB have any lambda auth or cookie rewrite? any WAF in front?
Jordan (Acme Integrations): no WAF, but we do have a small middleware that can rewrite cookie->bearer for our SSO flow (used for browser flows). might be configured on the istio gateway as an envoy filter.
Linda: can you capture the incoming headers at the ingressgateway pod? `kubectl exec -c proxy -- curl -sS -D - http://127.0.0.1:15000/listeners` is one way, or add a short debug route that dumps headers. even better: tcpdump on the node to ensure TLS termination point.
Jordan (Acme Integrations): dug in — we added a filter that transforms `X-SSO-Cookie` to `Authorization` for browser SSO. but our ALB sends `authorization` lowercase sometimes? example from failed request (ingressgateway access log):
```
"GET /v1/complete HTTP/1.1" 403 - "authorization: Bearer ey..." "x-sso-cookie: sid=abc"
```
Maya: envoy canonicalizes header names. but some of our authz code expects `Authorization` with capital A in a specific stage (legacy). odd. can you share the actual envoy filter config?
Jordan (Acme Integrations): snippet from the filter: 
```
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: EnvoyFilter
...
- name: cookie-to-bearer
  typed_config:
    '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.lua.v3.Lua
    inlineCode: |
      function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
        local cookie = request_handle:headers():get("x-sso-cookie")
        if cookie then
          request_handle:headers():add("authorization", "Bearer " .. cookie)
        end
      end
```
Ashok: that `:add` will create a lowercase header entry and may result in duplicate header entries depending on proxy normalization. also, if earlier filter removed `authorization` header for healthchecks or metrics, you can get racey behavior.
Linda: also check ALB behaviour: ALB can fold headers when forwarding. if TLS terminates at ALB and uses HTTP->HTTP2 downstream, header casing and multi-header behavior can change. recommend using `:replace` instead of `:add` and explicitly normalize to `Authorization`.
Maya: quick repro suggestion: 1) curl through ALB -> shows 403, 2) curl to ingressgateway clusterIP -> 200, 3) curl to ingressgateway but with `-H "authorization: <token>"` lowercase to see if pipeline cares about case. can you attach the access log from envoy at trace level?
Jordan (Acme Integrations): did the three tests. interestingly, when sending lowercase `authorization` directly, it fails; when sending capitalized `Authorization` it works when hitting ingressgateway. so ALB->istio seems to be normalizing to lowercase, and our Lua filter adds lowercase header later which ends up being ignored by our downstream authz microservice (it only checks capitalized header due to a library bug).
sre-bot: automated note — please attach request ids for failed requests (x-request-id).
Ashok: two immediate fixes: 1) change Lua to `request_handle:headers():replace("Authorization", "Bearer " .. cookie)` so header is present with proper canonical name; 2) patch the auth library in the microservice to lookup headers case-insensitively (longer term).
Linda: also ensure the envoy filter is applied at the correct listener (gateway vs sidecar) — putting it at the gateway listener ensures cookie->bearer happens before any header-mangling. and add a small unit test: `curl -H "authorization: foo"` vs `-H "Authorization: foo"` through ALB to confirm.
Jordan (Acme Integrations): applied replace + moved filter to gateway listener. rolling out a canary now. initial canary shows success. thanks.
Maya: great. for bookkeeping, can you add the final root cause and the fix to the ticket? label as `dedicated-vpc:auth-header-normalization` and tag eng-infra for a follow-up to add an integration test for ALB casing edge-case. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Acme Integrations): will do, attaching logs and config diffs. thanks everyone!
Maya: marking this thread for closure — reopen if it reoccurs.
